newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-DODGERS, CHAN HO PARK AGREE ON 1997 CONTRACT.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-DODGERS, CHAN HO PARK AGREE ON 1997 CONTRACT.

text.p: The Los Angeles Dodgers agreed to terms Tuesday on a one-year contract with South Korean pitcher Chan Ho Park, who will be battling for a spot in the team's rotation.
The 23-year-old Park went 5-5 last season with 119 strikeouts and a 3.64 earned run average over 48 appearances (10 starts), spanning 108 2/3 innings.
The Korean right-hander also enjoyed a fine winter, compiling a 2-2 mark and 1.35 ERA in seven starts and one relief outing for Azucareros of the Dominican League.
Park, who made two appearances in both 1994 and 1995 with the Dodgers, will vie for the fifth spot in the rotation with veteran knuckleballer Tom Candiotti.
